svg.title: Umbra: measured speed and completed agent workflows
svg.desc: On the same local fixture, Umbra daemon socket snapshots took 0.94 ms versus 3.57 ms for Playwright Chromium, 3.8 times faster. Clicks plus DOM update took 1.52 versus 16.02 ms, 10.5 times faster. Twenty measured runs per cell; excludes MCP framing. Umbra earned full reward on 517/625 MiniWoB++ cases in an adapted MCP setup, and passed 70/70 project-authored workflow regression runs. These are scoped observations, not a general superiority claim.
